purpose: Machine-readable capability map for the v1.1 reasoning-compiler bar. Each row names the input object, check or transform, output object, and falsifier that keep the capability inspectable.

capabilities.label: Claim boundary compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Turn an informal project question into a thesis, limits, and a concrete change test.
capabilities.input_object: Project brief JSON, thesis text, ruled-out alternatives, source files, evidence files, and next-falsifier field.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Project brief validation, source preflight, falsifier checks, and claim-support inspection.
capabilities.output_object: Bounded project brief, thesis/support rows, non-claim boundary, and next-falsifier state.
capabilities.falsifier: A project can pass while the Workbench, trace, and saved project file disagree on the thesis, limits, or next falsifier.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: The selected project must show the thesis, assumptions, caveats, change test, source files, evidence files, and next action from the same project object.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Project / Charter, Project / Thesis, or save the project file; the same charter, thesis, and change test must match `ztare forensic-workbench project-state --project <project> --json`.
capabilities.current_boundary: Implemented for local project files and public demos; not a hosted multi-user claim system.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Project / Charter; Project / Thesis; Files / Project brief; saved project file

capabilities.label: Source and evidence compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Know which local files support the thesis and which evidence gaps still block confidence.
capabilities.input_object: Raw source files, source type map, evidence files, compiled evidence file, and evidence-gap saved records.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Source check, source index, evidence binding, replay, evidence fetch, and gap-justification saved records.
capabilities.output_object: Source readiness, evidence readiness, evidence support, active gaps, and source/evidence saved records.
capabilities.falsifier: A source or evidence warning can be cleared without a target path, saved-record path, or inspectable backing file.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Files and evidence views must group source files, compiled evidence, active gaps, and backing files by the user's next repair task.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Files / Prepare files or Project / Evidence summary; every repair action must show its source path, target path, and saved-record path before it writes.
capabilities.current_boundary: Strongest on local projects with typed files; external evidence fetching depends on configured providers.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Files / Prepare files; Project / Evidence summary; file viewer

capabilities.label: Run-readiness compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Know whether the next local run is allowed before spending model calls or trusting a score.
capabilities.input_object: Project brief, rubric, source/evidence state, launch command, and trace context.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Autoresearch trace, plan preview, source/evidence preflight, rubric validation, and preflight-only run.
capabilities.output_object: Run-readiness state, recommended first command, blockers, recovery channel, and preflight saved record.
capabilities.falsifier: A project can start a model-spend run while source, evidence, rubric, or preflight state is still blocked.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Run readiness must separate no-spend inspection, preflight, and confirmed run launch, with blockers visible before any model-spend action.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Run / Ready to run and Run / Check readiness; the command and blockers must match `ztare autoresearch trace --project <project> --rubric <rubric> --intake <intake.json> --json`.
capabilities.current_boundary: No-spend trace/preflight path is public; full runs still depend on configured models.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Run / Ready to run; Run / Check readiness; Run / Start run

capabilities.label: Expression-grammar compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Know whether a candidate mathematical form was composed from the declared primitive set before trusting a fit or score.
capabilities.input_object: Rubric grammar fields, fit declaration, Python model body, declared variables and parameters, evidence file, and grammar-specific primitive such as eml(x, y).
capabilities.check_or_transform: Rubric preflight, expression grammar validation, Python model grammar validation, deterministic fit compilation, and grammar-compliance scoring.
capabilities.output_object: Grammar-legal fit candidate, fail-closed primitive escape, fitted parameters, gate verdict, or vocabulary-reachability finding.
capabilities.falsifier: A candidate using forbidden math functions can pass as if it obeyed `eml_only` or `math_exp_only`, or a restricted grammar is blamed before a reachability probe shows the target is outside the grammar.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Run results must show the declared grammar, fitted form, complexity signal, and any grammar escape or reachability failure as inspectable artifacts.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Run / Ready to run and the file viewer for the fit artifact; a forbidden primitive must appear as a failed check, not as a valid score improvement.
capabilities.current_boundary: Implemented for selected local grammars and Planck/OEIS-style rubrics; not a general theorem that one primitive set fits all domains.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Run / Ready to run; file viewer

capabilities.label: Run-result compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Understand what a run changed: score movement, weak point, demotion, support issue, or next check.
capabilities.input_object: Run artifacts, scores, weakest points, provider telemetry, constraints, and action links.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Validator loop, deterministic gates, support checks, carrier replay, and run-history rendering.
capabilities.output_object: Verdict, demotion or support issue, run history, derived constraints, and suggested next check.
capabilities.falsifier: A run result is shown as progress without before/after state, score boundary, weak point, or backing artifact.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Run history must show latest score, best score, weak point, run count, backing artifact, and the next check selected by the project state.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Run / Ready to run; the score and weak point must match the append-only run history or trace output, not only a stale latest-result overlay.
capabilities.current_boundary: Run history and replay are implemented; serious-project before/after narratives remain a v1.1 hardening target.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Run / Ready to run; Project / Overview; saved project file

capabilities.label: Compression-progress compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Know whether a research route is making the explanation simpler or only producing different-looking churn.
capabilities.input_object: Iteration telemetry, fit-result BIC, MDL-style description length, proof/script length, effort, and run history.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Compression-progress replay, complexity/runtime profile construction, stagnation check, and advisory recommendation.
capabilities.output_object: Advisory continue/watch/narrow-or-pivot signal, shorter-explanation profile, effort summary, and backing fit or telemetry files.
capabilities.falsifier: A score-improving route is shown as progress even when description length stays flat and no backing complexity profile is available.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Run results must label compression progress as advisory, show the recent complexity profile, and keep it next to score and effort rather than replacing them.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Run / Ready to run for a project with BIC/MDL-style telemetry; the visible advice must match `compression_progress_replay.py --project <project> --json`.
capabilities.current_boundary: Advisory only. It is surfaced in run history and replay, but it does not control run admission or pivot decisions by itself.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Run / Ready to run; Project / Overview; file viewer

capabilities.label: Report-support compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Know whether a report can be used or must stay blocked because support is stale, missing, or unbound.
capabilities.input_object: Candidate report, synthesis ledger, backing artifacts, report-input saved record, and support contract.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Synthesis refresh, artifact digest binding, stale-output check, and report-support contract validation.
capabilities.output_object: Promoted report action or blocked report-support issue with backing files and next repair action.
capabilities.falsifier: A stale or unsupported report appears as current support in the Workbench, docs, or saved project file.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Report readiness must show whether the report is current, what support issue remains, the first allowed action, and the backing files before a review is saved.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Report / Report readiness; the support issue, next action, and backing files must match `ztare forensic-workbench report-action --project <project> --action check_readiness --renderer decision_brief --confirmed --json` output.
capabilities.current_boundary: Implemented for local synthesis/report-support paths; public claims remain bounded by support contracts.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Report / Report readiness; Report / Report inputs; file viewer

capabilities.label: Review and saved-history compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Save what a human accepted, deferred, repaired, or chose next, with proof of changed files.
capabilities.input_object: Review decision, next-step note, project file save request, source edit, or evidence-gap justification.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Workbench write boundary, review apply, next-step apply, source edit, project-file save, and saved-history update.
capabilities.output_object: Review record, next-step record, source/edit record, latest project file, and no-change boundary.
capabilities.falsifier: A Workbench write changes files without showing target path, saved-record path, and no-change boundary first.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Every write-capable panel must show what can change, what stays read-only, where the saved record lands, and what refreshed after saving.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Review / Saved history or Report / Project file after a save; the saved record path and changed artifact must be previewable from the Workbench.
capabilities.current_boundary: Local file-backed storage is implemented; detached cloud storage is a future provider boundary.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Review / Save review; Review / Save next step; Review / Saved history; Report / Project file

capabilities.label: Gaming and evaluator compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Bound evaluator-hardening claims to reproducible artifacts instead of trusting self-certification.
capabilities.input_object: Evaluator claim, gaming pattern, frozen benchmark artifact, benchmark evidence, and non-claim field.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Gaming catalog audit, frozen evaluator check, benchmark evidence check, and evidence packet check.
capabilities.output_object: Bounded evidence claim, missing-arm warning, non-claim, and reviewer-safe benchmark artifact.
capabilities.falsifier: A public evaluator-hardening claim passes without the frozen artifact or while the ordinary-review arm is still missing.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Public evidence claims must stay outside the project Workbench unless the frozen artifact, missing-arm status, and non-claim boundary are visible.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Run `make benchmark-evidence` or the frozen evaluator check; a missing artifact must block the claim instead of being hidden by prose.
capabilities.current_boundary: Selected proof points have public frozen evidence; no blanket evaluator superiority claim.

capabilities.label: Reflexive advisory compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Separate useful suggestions from stale diagnostics and from state-changing controls.
capabilities.input_object: Action recommendation, source-health row, forecast row, run-history archive, and decision-use evidence.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Action-intelligence materialization, source-health audit, forecast capability audit, and decision-use boundary check.
capabilities.output_object: Advisory row, source warning, hard blocker, or decision-use record with backing files.
capabilities.falsifier: A suggested next move is promoted to project state without source freshness, consumed-surface evidence, or backing files.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Warnings must be labeled as advisory, repair, or inspect actions with plain issue names and backing evidence paths.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Open Run / Fix warnings; each warning must match `action_intelligence.py health --json` source-health rows without duplicate issue identities.
capabilities.current_boundary: Action intelligence is advisory by default; stronger authority requires evidence of consumption and source freshness.
capabilities.workbench_surface: Run / Fix warnings; Project / Overview; action-intelligence read models

capabilities.label: Primitive compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Promote repeated reasoning moves into reusable machinery only when the selecting signal and refusal condition are explicit.
capabilities.input_object: Repeated residual, pattern invocation, primitive candidate, nearest confuser, and required artifact slot.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Primitive amnesia, pattern action contract, nearest-confuser check, and primitive health audit.
capabilities.output_object: Candidate primitive, typed action record, refusal, demotion, or cataloged reusable primitive.
capabilities.falsifier: A new primitive is promoted without the signal that selects it, the artifact it requires, or the condition that should demote it.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Primitive suggestions must remain a kernel/read-model backlog item until they name the user problem, selecting signal, required artifact, and demotion condition.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Run `ztare primitive health` or primitive amnesia; a suggested primitive must point to its nearest existing confuser before promotion.
capabilities.current_boundary: Primitive recall and pattern contracts are implemented; broad autonomous primitive generation remains below the line.

capabilities.label: Repository memory compiler
capabilities.user_problem: Find the existing module, primitive, route, map, or validator before adding duplicate machinery or breaking a live project path.
capabilities.input_object: Task description, changed file, symbol or route name, architecture-index row, graph edge, primitive-amnesia result, and workbench action contract.
capabilities.check_or_transform: Architecture-index validation, rendered index lookup, graph lookup, primitive recall, architecture-map drift check, and workbench route/action contract inspection.
capabilities.output_object: Owned module, consumer list, relevant primitive, stale-map warning, affected workbench action, and the next file or check to inspect.
capabilities.falsifier: A code change can alter a project-facing route, primitive, or read model without the repo naming the owner, consumer, stale map, or validation command that should catch it.
capabilities.workbench_requirement: Future repository-memory views must answer who owns this capability, what consumes it, what will break if it changes, and which existing primitive should be reused first.
capabilities.user_visible_proof: Run `python scripts/public/control/render_architecture_index.py --grep <term>`; structural questions must point to the architecture index, graph, primitive recall, route contract, or map validator rather than vague doc prose.
capabilities.current_boundary: The repository already has architecture indexes, maps, graph edges, primitive recall, and validators; v1.1 still needs one unified query surface over them.
